title: Native fixture
tagline: A tiny test game for the Hall's player.
teaser: Start a round, win or lose it and leave by every door. It exists so the Hall can prove native games run end to end: pause menu, results, XP and achievements.

manPage.synopsis: fixture-native — start a round, then win, lose or leave.
manPage.description: A native game written against the kit contract. Used by the end-to-end tests of the player; never listed in the Hall.

howToPlay: Press Start, then win or lose the round.
Every point you score counts once the round is over.
Esc pauses; on the title screen it takes you back to the Hall.

packages.description: Win a round of the native fixture.

packages.description: Restart a round from the pause menu.
